Chelsea v Tottenham Hotspur (Kick-off 5.30pm). Coverage of the Premier League match at Stamford Bridge. The Blues have won the last six meetings with their London rivals, including a 2-1 win in last season's corresponding fixture. However, Chelsea's two goal scorers in that match, Enzo Fernandez and Andrey Santos, have both since left the club. Tottenham's last victory against their hosts came in February 2023 when they won 2-0 at home thanks to goals from Oliver Skipp and Harry Kane.

The Reds defeated Brighton twice here last term, overcoming them 2-0 in the league and 3-0 in the FA Cup, but the Seagulls did gain a measure of revenge with a 2-1 victory at AMEX Stadium later in the campaign.

Sunderland v Leeds United (Kick-off 4.30pm). All the action from the Premier League match at Stadium of Light.
